source_limits: Historical close scope may differ from sales and current balances.
No lot receipt ages or complete movement documents. Recency is last observed positive sale in the branch.
Source monetary sale column is cost, not revenue.
No sales allocation by warehouse. Different quantity units are kept separate.
Cost contribution comparisons pair exact positions and separately identify new/missing records.
